The basic forest concept has developed into a more comprehensive concept that includes long-term ecological, social and economic developments.
tactical_explanations:
No more cases than regrowth: this is the forest's original practice. The stock remains the renewable basis of the yield. Sustainability begins as a rule of use in the forest, not as stock exchange jargon. The collection rule protects the regeneration capacity. The statement correctly reflects the origin and practice.

Young people limit the permissible collection. Those who fall more than grow back consume the stock and miss the original sense. The forest rule is the root of the later, further concept.

The statement is true.

Permanent timber yield and preserved tree stock are the two purposes of the same rule. Income without stock would be a depletion, stock without use would be another goal. The representation mentions both. Safe and preserved belong together. The statement holds this doubling.

The statement is true.

Often used, often unclear: this is how the section opens the definition work. The term therefore needs the historical and systematic clarification. Uncertainty is the reason, not a minor sigh. Without this warning, one could call any action lasting. The statement makes the diagnosed blur.

The equation of poverty and sustainable life is the confusion prohibited by the text. Similar tons of values do not change the fact that forced lack is not the safe place to act with social participation.

The statement is false.

title: Wozu Wirtschaft dient
context: Evaluate the following statements for the purpose and legitimacy of economic action:
statements: The main economic considerations are the question of what business serves.
If the economy does not serve the well-being of people, it loses its legitimacy.
Economic action always has the aim of maximizing the benefits as a theoretical model, not to promote the human well-being.
Economic action always has the goal of promoting human well-being.
Need, preference, benefits, well-being, life satisfaction and happiness all mean the same and can be exchanged at will.
tactical_explanations:
The purpose of the economy is to be found in every key figure. The section focuses on this issue of purpose and binds it to the well-being of people. Without this direction, production remains an end in itself. That is why the subchapter does not begin with a market model, but with legitimization.

Those who only count quantities and prices skip the first placement of the text. The purpose question is thus the framework into which later threshold value, doughnut and sufficiency are attached: without answer to what is managed, these instruments remain technology without scale.

Legitimization does not depend on turnover or growth in itself. If the economy does not serve well-being, it loses its justification according to the text. This is a hard condition, not a decorative mission. Growth that increases inequality, stress or environmental destruction can miss the same standard, even if the benefits increase.

The bond to human well-being remains the test stone.

The statement is true.

To set maximum benefits as the only goal, a model size is exchanged with the purpose. The presentation says explicitly: economic action is intended to promote the human well-being. Benefits explains decisions and measures short-term satisfaction from a preference, not justice or sustainability.

Those who explain the model size for the purpose, make an analytical tool the legitimation of the whole economy.

The statement is false.

Human well-being as a permanent goal is not a side-note. The sentence literally stands as a direction of economic action. Well-being, well-being and life satisfaction are closer to each other than benefits or happiness in the narrow sense. The goal later explains why the concepts have to be distinguished: only in this way can it be examined whether systems contribute to good life.

The statement is true.

Six words for the same thing rejects the representation. Needs, preferences, benefits, well-being, life satisfaction and happiness capture different levels, from objective prerequisites to subjective perception. The distinction is the prerequisite for not throwing decision, need and actual outcome into one.

An equation would destroy exactly this vote.

The statement is false.

title: Needs as objective prerequisites
context: Evaluate the following statements on needs as the basis of a decent life:
statements: Needs are objective prerequisites of human existence.
Nutrition, health, belonging and safety are examples of needs.
Needs are subjective assessments and culturally shaped.
To highlight needs, what needs to be fulfilled so that people can lead a decent life.
Needs are regarded as subjective preferences that can be shaped socially in any way.
tactical_explanations:
The objective prerequisites here do not mean a question of taste. Nutrition, health, belonging and safety must be given in order for human existence to succeed. The representation thus puts needs under a different logic than desires. Anyone who treats hunger as a mere preference misses precisely this objectivity.

The condition of existence remains independent of whether someone crosses it as a preference in a survey. This very objectivity bears the ethical point: what is existentially provided must not disappear into the wish list, otherwise the social minimum of the consumer corridor is missing later.

The statement is true.

Four examples consciously open the concept of need: metabolism, physical integrity, social belonging and protection. The section mentions nutrition, health, belonging and safety in one breath. None of these is a luxury wish. The list prevents shortening needs to calories or dismiss belonging as a soft extra.

The statement is true.

Subjective and cultural: this is the definition of preferences, not of needs. Needs remain objective prerequisites of existence. The confusion is the first typical short-circuit of the chapter. Whoever equates both, cannot describe advertising and status striving as distortion, because then every desire would be a need.

Note: Do not swap preference and need.

The statement is false.

Ethical relevance means: Needs mark the minimum content of a humane life. What must be fulfilled is thus a question of justice, not just a demand curve. The table mentions the minimum standard for justice on the objective level. Without this marking there would be no social ground in the later Doughnut.

Human dignity is the point of escape here, not maximizing fulfilled preferences. The mark says what justice depends on at least before preferences and benefits are modelled at all.

The statement is true.

The overview shows that needs are objective and a minimum standard of justice. Subjective and socially formable are the lines of preferences. Those who exchange the levels make a minimum of existence a formable preference. That is exactly what would deprive the later consumer corridor of its social minimum.

The statement is false.

title: Preferences and their distortions
context: Evaluate the following statements on preferences, culture and possible distortions:
statements: Preferentials are subjective assessments and culturally marked.
Preferences may reflect needs, but may also be distorted by advertising, status aspirations or social comparisons.
Preferentials are always morally and ecologically desirable.
People can also have environmentally harmful or socially destructive preferences.
Preferences are considered, just like needs, an objective minimum for justice.
tactical_explanations:
Subjective evaluation and cultural influence separate preferences from needs. What someone prefers is based on education, milieu and comparisons, not on a fixed core of existence. The presentation thus leaves room for change: preferences are malleable. That is why preference is not the sole measure of sustainable well-being.

Culturally, the same objective needs can create very different baskets of goods without the core of the need becoming a matter of taste. Formability is strength and risk: preferences can be turned towards sufficiency, but also towards status consumption, which blows the corridor upwards.

The statement is true.

Advertising, status aspirations and social comparisons are mentioned in the section as sources of distortion. A preference can meet a need but does not have to. The sentence keeps both possibilities open and warns against the naive equation desire equal need. Whoever considers any displayed preference authentic, overlooks precisely this distortion chain.

The openness of the sentence is the teaching: reflection is possible, automatic it is not. Whoever ignores the distortion channels treats every advertising effect as a revelation of a need.

The statement is true.

Preferentials would always be desirable only if wishes already guaranteed morality and ecology. The representation says the opposite: they are not always morally or ecologically desirable. Environmentally harmful and socially destructive preferences are expressly possible. The absolute claim deletes precisely this warning and would make consumer corridors superfluous.

The statement is false.

Environmentally harmful or socially destructive: the section explicitly allows such preferences. This is the idea that observed will is already good life. However, such desires can be useful because they measure what individuals want in a value-neutral way. The separation of will and dignity is the point here, not a teaching about taste.

The statement is true.

Minimum standard for justice is one of the needs at the objective level in the table. Preferences are subjective, socially formable and not always sustainable. Whoever makes preferences the minimum level of justice twists the lines and would explain formable desires to the social ground.

The statement is false.

title: Benefits, SWB and Life satisfaction
context: Evaluate the following statements to distinguish between benefits, subjective well-being and life satisfaction:
statements: The benefits are short-term satisfaction from the satisfaction of a preference.
Subjective well-being and life satisfaction refer to the overall judgment on one's own life.
Benefits measure justice and sustainability.
Economic growth can increase the benefits, but it can reduce the well-being if it increases social inequality, stress or environmental degradation.
Subjektives Wohlbefinden meint dasselbe wie kurzfristige, momentane Lust.
tactical_explanations:
Short-term satisfaction according to fulfilled preference: the presentation leads so closely to the benefit. It is about the satisfaction of a preference, not the judgment over the whole life. As model size, profit explains decisions. Whoever equates it with life satisfaction, makes a survival from a moment.

The statement is true.

The overall conclusion about one's own life is the formulation for subjective well-being and life satisfaction. The focus is on the sustainable quality of human existence. Momentary pleasure is not enough for this. The distinction bears the later thesis that growth can increase the benefit and reduce the well-being.

The statement is true.

Justice and sustainability do not measure the benefits. It is value-neutral and shows what individuals want. Justice depends on needs as a minimum standard, sustainability at social and ecological limits. Who makes benefits as a moral balance, loads the analytical size.

Note: Benefits remain value-neutral; he explains want, not good life. A value-neutral scale can represent environmentally harmful will and yet say nothing about a good life within planetary boundaries. That is why the section SWB and life satisfaction needs as a different level.

The statement is false.

Inequality, stress and environmental degradation can push well-being while benefits are still rising. The section mentions these three amplifiers as counter-movements to growth growth. The distinction is crucial: more fulfilled preferences are no proof of better quality of existence.

An increasing GDP-benefit pair can thus conceal a worse overall judgment on life. The benefit increases because preferences are fulfilled; the life judgement falls because comparison, stress and destruction spoil the whole. Both movements can be true at the same time as the concepts are not thrown into one.

The statement is true.

Momentary pleasure would be happiness in the narrow sense or the moment of benefit, not SWB. Subjective well-being and life satisfaction are aimed at the overall judgment and the sustainable quality of existence. The representation expressly demarcates this against mere pleasure. Anyone who shortens SWB to the short kick deletes this limit.

The statement is false.

title: Six concepts in the overview
context: Evaluate the following statements to distinguish the concepts around well-being:
statements: Needs describe basic prerequisites for a good life and are on the objective level.
Benefits is a theoretical model for explaining decisions and describes decision-making behavior, not well-being.
Happiness is the long-term assessment of one's life in the scheme.
Life satisfaction is a long-term assessment of one's own life and is considered empirically as a measure of the success of politics and institutions.
Subjective well-being, just like the benefit, is a purely analytical model size that describes only decision-making behavior.
tactical_explanations:
The basic prerequisites and objective level characterize needs. Their importance for sustainability is the minimum standard for justice that will later return as the social basis of the doughnut. A merely subjective reading of needs would tilt this basis. Without it, there would be no floor, just a ceiling, in the later corridor logic.

Justice therefore depends on the needs, not on the formable preferences.

The statement is true.

Analytical, not empirically well-being: benefits explain how they are chosen, not how well someone is actually doing. Benefits describe decision-making behavior, not well-being. Those who already read quality of life from the benefit index skip SWB and life satisfaction. The model size remains a tool, not a measure of success of society.

A model that predicts elections well has not yet shown that people are doing well.

The statement is true.

Long-term assessment of one's life is part of life satisfaction, not luck. Fortunately, it is a short-term positive emotion and an affective component of well-being. The confusion makes a political measure out of a push for emotion.

The statement is false.

Measuring politics and institutions against the long-term life judgement is the empirical role of life satisfaction. The presentation calls it measure of success, not just mood. This makes it understandable why income only correlates to a threshold: the judgment depends on more than the balance of accounts.

The statement is true.

Analytical model size for decision-making behavior is the benefit, not subjective well-being. SWB is an emotional and cognitive assessment of life and an indicator of social quality. Anyone who reduces SWB to a purely decision-making size takes the empiricity its actual indicator.

The statement is false.

title: Why Distinction Is Needed
context: Evaluate the following statements to the need, preference, benefit and well-being need to be separated:
statements: The distinction between terms helps to better reconcile economic, social and environmental objectives.
Only when concepts are distinguished can economics explain how people decide what they need and how well they actually do.
Benefit is value-neutral: it measures what individuals want, not justice or sustainability.
Well-being and life satisfaction do not indicate whether social systems contribute to good life.
Preferences are always a reliable mirror of objective needs.
tactical_explanations:
To bring three types of targets into line, only if the words do not run into confusion. Explain economically, ensure socially just, limit ecologically: the presentation binds the separation of concepts to precisely this coordination. Without it, benefits would already be considered sustainability or desire as a need. The distinction is an instrument, not word-giving.

In concrete terms, voting means: do not spend the benefit on sustainability, do not confuse needs with advertising and do not reduce life satisfaction to the short kick.

The statement is true.

Deciding, needing, going: three questions, three concepts. Benefits and preferences carry the decision, needs the need, well-being and life satisfaction the actual outcome. The section says that only the distinction allows all three simultaneously and the derivative of sustainable well-being. A mix would swallow one of the three questions.

Sustainable well-being follows only from this triad, not from a single curve. Those who model the decision-making behavior will not experience the need or the progress. Deriving how sustainable well-being is achieved assumes that these three levels remain visible.

The statement is true.

Value-neutral means: the benefits count to want, not to want. Justice and sustainability are outside its scale. Therefore, a high benefit can be associated with environmentally harmful preferences. Neutrality is the strength of the decision-making model and the limit at the same time as politics seeks good life within planetary boundaries.

The statement is true.

The role of well-being and life satisfaction is the role of good life. The representation presents it as a test of social systems. The negation removes this indicator. Then only the benefits remain, and it measures wills, not whether systems carry.

The statement is false.

Reliable mirror would be the exception, not the rule. Preferences can reflect needs, but they can be distorted. Advertising, status and comparisons are explicit. Always to maintain reliable, cancels the distortion and makes a need out of every desire.

The statement is false.

title: Income and life satisfaction
context: Evaluate the following statements on the empirical relationship between income and life satisfaction:
statements: Empirical evidence shows that income only correlates to a certain threshold with life satisfaction.
Health, social relations, trust and participation are more important than an unlimited income relationship.
Above every income level, life satisfaction increases proportionally and without threshold.
The World Happiness Report 2025 is named as a supporting line alongside works by Ferrer-i-Carbonell.
Income is the only empirical determinant of life satisfaction.
tactical_explanations:
Only up to a threshold: this is how the representation limits income correlation. Among these, more income can be accompanied by higher life satisfaction, and the connection loses strength. The point is qualitative, not a memorized euro limit. Anyone reading income as an unlimited engine of happiness contradicts this threshold finding.

Under the threshold, income can fill existential gaps and raise the life's judgment; health, attachment and trust gain the greater role. The correlation does not end at zero, it loses priority.

The statement is true.

Health, relationships, trust and participation are more important than the other things. The section opposes the idea that life satisfaction is primarily based on income. Participation and trust are therefore in the same league as health, not in a soft residual category. The ranking later on carries the country's findings to institutional quality.

Participation and trust are not soft extra points besides the pay, but the sizes with which the World Happiness Report later describes happy countries.

The statement is true.

Without a threshold to go further, the exact reading that the empirical finding collects is. Correlation only to a certain threshold means: at some point more income does not carry life satisfaction to the same extent. A proportional infinity would push health, relationships and trust aside. The representation does the opposite.

The statement is false.

Ferrer-i-Carbonell and the World Happiness Report 2025 are examples in a parenthesis. The section bases the threshold finding and the following determinants on this line, not on a single anecdote. The names mark Empirie, but they do not replace the content statement about threshold and ranking.

The statement is true.

Only income factor would delete the list. Health, social relations, trust, participation, relative comparisons, unemployment, uncertainty and education occur explicitly. The narrowing of money alone contradicts the enumeration and the sentence that income correlates only to a threshold.

The statement is false.

title: Comparisons, unemployment and education
context: Evaluate the following statements relative comparisons, uncertainty and education as determinants of well-being:
statements: People value their happiness in relation to others.

Education increases life satisfaction through self-effectiveness and employment prospects.
Relative comparisons do not matter for the judgment of happiness.
Loss of income always reduces well-being more than unemployment.
tactical_explanations:
In relation to others: happiness is relative here, not only absolute. The presentation calls relative comparisons as a point of its own, next to the income threshold. Anyone who sees only their own account underestimates neighbours, colleagues and status. Exactly this relativity explains why growth can increase the benefit and still push well-being as inequality increases.

Status and neighbourhood account can devalue an income increase as others increase faster. Relativity makes inequality a direct channel into the lucky judgment, not just a distribution attachment.

The statement is true.

Stronger than income losses: Unemployment and uncertainty are more profound than a mere minus. The section explicitly establishes this ranking. Loss of the job and lack of security meet self-effectiveness, belonging and future expectation. A pure income replacement without security would not cancel this difference.

If you replace only the failed salary, unemployment is treated as a pure income shock and underestimates loss of role, security and future, which the section weighs more heavily.

The statement is true.

Self-efficacy and employment prospects are the two channels through which education raises life satisfaction. The presentation does not call a magical educational title, but these ways of action. Anyone who reads education only as an income machine leaves away self-efficacy. Both paths belong to the empirical list, not only one.

The statement is true.

No role to claim for comparisons is to strike one of the four empirical points. People evaluate their happiness in relation to others. The negation would close the status and comparison channel that the presentation is opening. Relative situation thus remains part of the happiness evaluation.

The statement is false.

The situation is that unemployment and insecurity are reducing well-being more than income loss. The reversal is a smaller one from the lower cut. That's not exactly what it says.

The statement is false.

title: Happy Countries and Youth
context: Evaluate the following statements on the World Happiness Report and on the Life Satisfaction of Young People:
statements: The World Happiness Report 2025 shows that countries with high values for social trust, institutional quality and environmental awareness are also the happiest.

For young people, life satisfaction depends heavily on sense, security and social inclusion.
The report traces the happiness of these countries alone to a particularly high per capita income.
For young people, life satisfaction is mainly dependent on material consumption, less on meaning or social inclusion.

Social trust, institutional quality and environmental awareness are the common pattern of the happiest countries. The World Happiness Report 2025 provides exactly this three-way binding, not a purely income ranking. If you cut one of the three sizes, you break the pattern.

Happiness and sustainability are empirically linked before the Doughnut is formally introduced. The list is illustration, not a closed World Cup. It prevents the misconception that happiness is just a question of tropical leisure or pure purchasing power.

The examples are deliberately located in very different parts of the world, bound by the same pattern, not by a single currency or a common climate.

The statement is true.

The young people's diagnosis of meaning, security and social inclusion are the key factors in the diagnosis of life. Life satisfaction at this age depends heavily on these three dimensions. The formulation meets the later observation, while young people combine happiness with meaningfulness and co-design.

The statement is true.

Setting income per capita alone as a cause contradicts the threefold commitment mentioned above. Trust, institutions and environmental awareness are the values highlighted in the report set. Income remains bound to a threshold in the chapter and is not the sole explanation. The narrowing to purchasing power alone tilts the finding.

The statement is false.

Above all, material consumption for young people: the presentation says the opposite of the later trend passage and already here sense, safety, inclusion. Material equipment is not the guiding factor of this age group in the presentation. Whoever makes consumption the main anchor, prepares the wrong contrast to Gallup passage.

The statement is false.

title: Youth, Climate Fear and Sense

Young people increasingly combine happiness with meaningfulness, natural experience and co-design rather than material consumption.
These empirical trends show that well-being is inextricably linked to sustainability in the 21st century.
Young people increasingly associate happiness with material consumption.
The Gallup data 2023 describe all age groups worldwide with the same percentage.

Europe, 18 to 29 years old, almost 60 percent, climate and society: four limitations of Gallup figure 2023. The representation does not set the number as the world law of all age cohorts. The concern for the future is the qualitative point, the magnitude underlines it. Whoever cuts the cohort or the space makes a targeted finding an all-statement.

Meaningfulness, nature experience and co-design take the place of material consumption as a fortune anchor. The section speaks of an increasing awareness of sustainability in this very shift. Those who separate well-being and sustainability contradict this final sentence of the youth passage. The inseparability is the bridge from the youth sociology to the doughnut: those who separate sense and climate can no longer describe the 21st century in this chapter. Kate Raworth's two rings are prepared in this way, not re-edited as ornaments.

The statement is true.

Increasingly, material consumption would be the counter-movement to what the presentation describes. Happiness is shifting to meaning, nature and co-design. The claim tilts the trend and would undermine the inseparability of well-being and sustainability. That is exactly not what the Gallup passage says.

The statement is false.

All age groups worldwide with the same percentage: this is the most extreme. Named are Europe and the 18-29-year-olds. A global all-age statistics does not provide the section here. The extension makes a cohort-specific finding a sham generalization.

The statement is false.

title: Doughnut: social basis and ecological ceiling
context: Evaluate the following statements zu Kate Raworths Doughnut-Modell:
statements: Kate Raworth's model of the doughnut combines a social basis, i.e. basic needs for all humans, with an ecological ceiling of planetary stress limits.

The goal of sustainable economy is a good life for all within planetary boundaries.

Two rings, two target sizes: the social basis of the basic needs for all, the ecological ceiling of the planetary stress limits, below. Raworth combines both, not just one. The doughnut thus becomes the image for sustainable well-being, which the section introduces according to the happiness findings.

Between the rings, the green area is a safe and just space for action. Certainly, it refers to the ecological ceiling, just to the social basis. Economics is supposed to be in this space, not below into the social deficit and not above into the excess. Figure 17 shows precisely this tension from deficits and overwritings.

Under the inner ring begins the social deficit, above which the external one overwrites the ecological one. Only the space between the two is considered safe and just, not even every green rhetoric.

The statement is true.

Only ecologically without a social basis: this would be a single ring, not a doughnut. The representation explicitly mentions both target sizes. Basic needs for all are the inner boundary, not an addition. The negation of the social base contradicts the first ball point line of the model.

The statement is false.

Good life for all within planetary boundaries is the target formula according to the Doughnut Monitor. It translates social basis plus ecological ceiling into an economic policy direction. All and inside: both words count. A good life for few beyond the borders or for all under the social soil misses the formula.

The statement is true.

The social foundation of poorer countries is confused with the ecological ceiling, and the ceiling is planetary stress limits. According to the monitor, the social foundation is rather poorer countries, while rich ones cross the ecological boundaries. The exchange is distorting this empiricism.

Note: Inner ring social minimum, outer ring ecological ceiling. Poorer countries appear in the monitor above all as a deficit, rich outside as surplus. Anyone who makes the ceiling a foundation can no longer read this asymmetry.

The statement is false.

title: Doughnut Monitor 2025
context: Evaluate the following statements on the empirical findings of the Doughnut Monitor 2025:

Under the social foundation, the poorer countries lie in this picture. Basic needs for all are not met there. The inner ring is the deficit, not the ecological ceiling. Together with the surplus of the rich, the global imbalance arises, which no country brings into the safe and just space.

The statement is true.

Already all minimum social standards within the limits: this would be the negation of "no land". The monitor leaves this fulfilled cell empty. Individual progress does not change the representation into a complete double-filling. The claim directly contradicts the first monitor point.

The statement is false.

Typically, the foundations of rich people were broken and the ceiling of poor people was torn: this is the swapped map. The representation assigns ecologically far-reaching social progress to the poorer countries. The reversal would make the Doughnut finding the opposite and misaddress the goal of a good life for all within the borders.

The addressees exchange with the rings: rich people must keep to the ceiling, poor people reach the foundation, and no one has both already completely.

The statement is false.

title: Consumer corridor between minimum and maximum
context: Evaluate the following statements on the consumption corridor:
statements: A consumer corridor defines the range between a social minimum and an ecological maximum.
Malnutrition is below the social minimum.
Excessive meat and energy consumption is above the ecological maximum.
The consumer corridor knows only a ceiling and no social minimum.
Malnutrition is above the ecological maximum in the example.
tactical_explanations:
What is necessary to live well and what the planet can endure permanently: in between lies the corridor. Social minimum and ecological maximum span the area. The term translates the doughnut into everyday consumption. Whoever calls only the maximum leaves people under the ground; whoever calls only the minimum ignores the ceiling.

The corridor is thus everyday translation of the doughnut: below decent life, above planetary load capacity, between permitted consumption instead of any more. Any more would be no corridor, but the old coupling of consumption and desire without floor and ceiling.

The statement is true.

Malnutrition as a situation below the minimum makes the social soil concrete. Being able to live well presupposes nutrition, which the catalogue of needs already mentioned at the beginning. The example shows understep, not overstep. Hunger is thus corridor injury downwards, not ecologically too much. Diet as a need from the beginning of the chapter returns here as a lower limit.

Those who treat hunger as a matter of taste have already left the corridor downwards.

The statement is true.

Meat and energy in excess push up against what the planet can withstand permanently. The illustration sets both as an example above the maximum. The corridor thus has a visible ceiling in everyday life, not only within abstract Earth system boundaries.

The statement is true.

Only upper limit without a social minimum would be a half corridor. The section defines the area between both brands. Malnutrition as a counter-example to the over-example would then be incomprehensible. The narrowing to the maximum alone strikes the justice side, which corresponds to Raworth's inner base.

The statement is false.

Putting malnutrition above the ecological maximum distorts the example pair. Down below hunger, above excessive meat and energy consumption: that's what it says. Whoever declares hunger to be a planetary transgression confuses deficit and coating and turns a social fall into an ecological blanket injury.

The statement is false.

title: Production corridor and needs
context: Evaluate the following statements to the production corridor:
statements: A production corridor describes the goods and services that should be produced in what form to meet needs without exceeding ecological boundaries.
These concepts directly link to subjective well-being.
The production corridor only sets market prices and does not say anything about types of goods or production.

The production corridor replaces needs with pure use as a yardstick of what is to be produced.
tactical_explanations:
What goods, what services, what form: three pieces of determination of the production corridor. Production should be made to meet needs, in such a way that ecological boundaries are maintained. The sentence combines the need ethics from the beginning of the chapter with the planetary ceiling. Any list of goods according to willingness to pay alone would be different from this corridor.

Form of production means technology, intensity and mix, not only the quantity. To produce at the same time in accordance with requirements and borderline, excludes goods that only serve preferences and tear the ceiling.

Consumer and production corridors are directly linked to subjective well-being. The bridge is a study of decreasing increases in satisfaction in case of excessive consumption and sufficiency. Production within the borders is thus not only aimed at tons and emissions, but at more stable well-being.

The concepts remain anthropocentric in the sense of the chapter title, not only technically. More stable well-being through sufficiency is the empirical hold of this bond: the corridors are not an ecological penal zone, but the area in which satisfaction does not crumble with every more.

The statement is true.

To set prices only would be market mechanics, not corridor. The section asks for goods, services and form of manufacture. Prices do not occur in this definition. Whoever makes the corridor to the price authority, removes need satisfaction and ecological limit as content.

The statement is false.

To satisfy needs without crossing the border: this is the purpose in a sentence. It states that not every preference has production rights, but the objective need within the ceiling. The formula combines minimum standard and planetary boundary operational. That is exactly how sustainable economics becomes a set-up from happiness report to quantity.

The statement is true.

Pure use as a production scale would replace value-neutral desire. The presentation speaks of satisfaction of needs, not of maximizing the value of production. Environmentally harmful preferences should then blow up the corridor. The replacement tilts the ethical point of the chapter.

The statement is false.

title: Sufficientness and decreasing growth
context: Evaluate the following statements excessive consumption, sufficiency and well-being:
