Unlimited consumption increases the level of well-being linearly and without decreasing growth.
tactical_explanations:
The next unit of goods increases satisfaction less than the previous unit, as consumption becomes excessive. The presentation is based on studies and binds it to the corridor idea. More is not noticeable at some point better, while ecological costs continue.

This is precisely why excessive meat and energy consumption is above the maximum, not in a happiness-optimum. However, ecological costs continue to run, even if the increase in satisfaction is shrinking. Precisely this separation of load and profit makes the maximum of the corridor necessary.

The statement is true.

Enough, but not too much: this is how the section "sucficiency" clings. Long-term, more stable well-being is the claimed consequence, not ascetic gap below the social minimum. Stability is against the short benefit kick of excessive consumption. So, sufficiency is in the corridor, not below and not above.

Under the minimum, hunger would be sufficient, above the maximum excess. The staple addition enough, but not too much, keeps the situation in the corridor and contradicts asceticism as well as excess.

The statement is true.

As much as possible, as long as the benefits increase, maximum benefits would be without ceiling. Sufficency means enough, but not too much. The benefits can continue to climb in environmentally harmful preferences, while well-being and planet suffer. The equation of sufficiency with maximum benefits eliminates exactly the corridor logic.

The statement is false.

The corridors in the final part are explicitly bound to SWB. Excessive consumption and sufficiency are called empirical bridges. Thus, the human indicator remains subjective well-being, not an ecological extra without humans. The bond closes the gap from the purpose question at the beginning to the form of production at the end.

The statement is true.

Linear without decreasing growth would reverse the study findings. Excessive consumption brings decreasing increases in satisfaction. Unlimitedness as a feel-good machine contradicts threshold value, comparison and sufficiency at the same time. The sentence is incompatible with the end of the chapter.

The statement is false.

title: Growth, benefits and reduced well-being
context: Evaluate the following statements to the tension of growth, benefits and sustainable well-being:
statements: Economic growth can increase benefits and yet reduce well-being if social inequality, stress or environmental degradation are intensified.
This distinction between benefit and well-being is crucial.
If the benefits increase through growth, the well-being always increases to the same extent.
If the economy does not serve the well-being of people, it loses its legitimacy.
Subjective well-being is identical to short-term satisfaction from the satisfaction of a single preference.
tactical_explanations:
Benefits high, well-being down: the mechanism runs through inequality, stress and environmental destruction. Growth then fulfills more preferences or raises short-term satisfaction while the overall judgment about life suffers. Relative comparisons make inequality noticeable, uncertainty and ecological burden additionally push.

The sentence is the central warning of the theory part before empiricism and doughnut follow. Whoever equates growth with well-being does not read exactly these amplifiers. SWB as an overall judgment can fall, while individual fulfilled desires still nourish the benefit. The three amplifiers are the visible wedges between both curves, not any additional risks.

The statement is true.

The presentation calls the separation decisive, because otherwise growth successes would be recorded as life successes. The benefits remain the short preference satisfaction, well-being the overall judgment of sustainable quality of existence. Without the separation there would be no sense of threshold, sufficiency and corridors.

The emphasis is both methodological and political: it changes the way the economy is measured.

The statement is true.

Always increasing in step with the benefit would be denying the mechanism mentioned. The section notes that well-being can decrease despite the benefit increase. Equal step would declare inequality, stress and environmental destruction to be unsuccessful. Precisely this inconsequentiality rejects the representation.

The statement is false.

Legitimization of the well-being of people: the opening sentence returns at the end of the argumentation, now with Doughnut, corridor and sufficiency in the back. If the economy does not serve this measure, it loses its justification.

The arc from the purpose question to the planetary boundary remains closed.

The statement is true.

Short-term satisfaction from a preference is the benefit, not SWB. Subjective well-being is emotional and cognitive assessment of life, empirical indicator of social quality, directed towards sustainable existence, not at present lust.

The identity of both sizes would make growth criticism, gallup findings and sufficiency incomprehensible, because then every consumption kick would be well-being.

Note: The short kick remains to benefit; SWB is the judgment of life. Identity of both sizes would mean that any advertising success is already social quality. The section separates the levels precisely because otherwise growth criticism and sufficiency no longer have an indicator.

The statement is false.

title: Environmental quality and life satisfaction
context: Evaluate the following statements on the relationship between environmental quality and life satisfaction:
statements: Clean air, green spaces and intact ecosystems increase life satisfaction measurable.
Noise, air pollution and surface sealing reduce life satisfaction.
Noise increases life satisfaction according to the empirical studies mentioned.
The environmental factors mentioned here have an empirical impact on life satisfaction.
Surface sealing increases life satisfaction measurable.
tactical_explanations:
In this section, empirical studies combine clean air, green spaces and intact ecosystems with higher life satisfaction, not only with an undetermined sense of well-being. The three environmental goods stand side by side as increasing factors. Those who only let parks apply and remove air and ecosystems shorten the list.

The direction is clear upwards, not indifferent. Life satisfaction is thus bound to concrete environmental quality, not to a mere sense of landscape without finding.

Those who separate the three goods act as if only the urban green were empirically proven. The section puts air, spaces and ecosystems in a row and binds all three to measurable life satisfaction. This series just explains why environmental quality is a social prerequisite here and not a private taste judgement about landscape.

The statement is true.

Noise, exhaust gases in the air and sealed surfaces act in the opposite direction in the same studies: they reduce life satisfaction. The three loads belong to the minus side of the same empirical comparison, not to a separate debate about urban planning without luck reference. Anyone who harks seal as neutral, leaves away exactly this lowering effect.

The direction is decrease, not increase.

The same level of study that raises plus factors is pushing the minus factors. No noise remains a mere comfort issue, air pollution no purely medical and sealing no only urban detail: all three reduce satisfaction.

The statement is true.

The section deals with noise, together with air pollution and surface sealing, and the factors that reduce it. There is no increase in life satisfaction due to noise. The empirical pattern remains: stress expresses satisfaction, it does not raise it.

The statement is false.

The study list begins with air, green and ecosystems and sets the counterpart in noise, pollution and sealing. Both aim at life satisfaction as measured size, not a pure income account. Environmental quality is thus a separate empirical lever. The sentence meets this empirical bond without memorizing a number.

Without this empirical bond, environmental quality would remain a moral desire. The presentation makes it the result: Life satisfaction responds to the environment, upwards and downwards.

The statement is true.

Reading sealed surfaces as a plus of luck contradicts the minus list. Surface sealing is the key factor in reducing life satisfaction. A measurable increase through sealing does not claim the presentation. The sign remains negative, analogous to noise and air pollution.

The statement is false.

title: Nature and mental health
context: Evaluate the following statements on natural attachment, mental health and resilience:
statements: Nature's attachment strengthens mental health and resilience.
Natural attachment weakens mental health.
Empirical studies combine environmental quality with measurable life satisfaction.
Only income determines life satisfaction; environmental quality does not matter.
Intact ecosystems are among the factors that increase life satisfaction.
tactical_explanations:
Nature is not a romantic side note, but a strengthening of mental health and resilience. Both targets are mentioned together. Whoever only means recreation in the park and cuts resilience leaves the second half away. The direction is strengthening, not weakening. The result is in the same empirical series as air, green and ecosystems.

Psychic health and resilience are two goals, not synonymous with a short nature feeling on the weekend. The section is both attached to nature's attachment and sets this sentence directly behind the environmental lists to air, green and ecosystems. Thus, connectedness becomes a social prerequisite for well-being, not a leisure taste.

The statement is true.

The section explicitly says that natural attachment strengthens mental health and resilience. There is no weakening of mental health through natural attachment. The sign remains positive for health and resistance.

The statement is false.

Clean air, green spaces and intact ecosystems increase life satisfaction measurable: this is the first empirical point of the section. Environmental quality and life satisfaction are linked to this, not separated from each other. The sentence gives this study result without requiring a single percentage.

The statement is true.

The entire environmental list only covers the use of income as a determinant. The presentation lists measurable effects of air, green, ecosystems, noise, pollution and sealing on life satisfaction. Environmental quality plays a role, it is not ineffective. The absolute "only" makes the sentence too narrow compared to the section.

The absolute "only" is the trap. As soon as income alone decides, noise, sealing and clean air must be ineffective. However, the presentation explicitly leads them as levers of life satisfaction. Environmental quality thus remains a separate factor in addition to every income history.

The statement is false.

Intact ecosystems are in the plus list next to clean air and green spaces. They increase life satisfaction measurable, they are not just a backdrop word. Whoever takes ecosystems out of the satisfaction effect disassembles exactly this trio. The sentence keeps the assignment of the text.

Ecosystems are not as biological extras besides satisfaction, but in the plus list. Those who only assign them to nature conservation and withdraw them from happiness, dissect precisely the trio with which the section establishes the measurable increase.

The statement is true.

title: Healthy Lifetime Income after Prettner
context: Evaluate the following statements to the indicator of the Healthy Lifetime Income:
statements: Prettner et al. (2023) shows with the indicator of the Healthy Lifetime Income that countries with higher life expectancy and better health care achieve a significantly higher level of well-being, even with more moderate material prosperity.
The indicator links well-being to life expectancy and health care, not to material prosperity alone.
Moderate material wealth, according to this finding, excludes any higher well-being.
Health and life expectancy count in this finding alongside material prosperity.
The indicator shows that only the highest income generates a higher level of well-being.
tactical_explanations:
Prettner and colleagues 2023 use the Healthy Lifetime Income as an indicator. The result is: higher life expectancy and better health care are accompanied by significantly higher well-being, even if material prosperity is only moderate. Health counts, not only the peak income.

The sentence fully reflects this evidence, including the restriction "even with more moderate material prosperity."

The point is in the restriction "even with more moderate material prosperity". Without it, the indicator would be another income ranking. It makes it visible that years of life in health can bear the well-being where material prosperity is not at the top. This is exactly what Prettner et al. 2023 proves with the Healthy Lifetime Income.

The statement is true.

Life expectancy and care form the bridge to well-being in the indicator. Material prosperity remains in the picture, but is not the only condition. That is why countries with only moderate material levels can nevertheless achieve a higher level of well-being if health and years of life are better off.

If material prosperity alone were to count, there would be no reason to mention life expectancy and care as indicators. The presentation calls it and allows moderates to materially express themselves. Well-being is thus bound to healthy life, not to a mere wealth maxim.

The statement is true.

Exclusion of higher well-being with only moderate material prosperity is the opposite of the finding. The presentation explicitly emphasizes that higher well-being is achieved even with more moderate material prosperity, provided life expectancy and health care are better. The absolute, which makes moderates the reason for exclusion, contradicts this point.

The statement is false.

In addition to material prosperity, life expectancy and health care are the values on which the indicator of well-being is fixed. Anyone who hides health reads the Healthy Lifetime Income as a mere income measure. The section explicitly lists both health values. The sentence stops this count.

The statement is true.

Only the highest income as a producer of higher well-being is allowed to change the indicator. The evidence is that better health and longer life can carry a higher level, even without top welfare. The absolute "only" excludes exactly the case that Prettner et al. open.

Highest income as the only source of higher well-being would exclude the case "moderate but healthy and durable." This is exactly the case that opens the indicator. The absolute "only" stands against the evidence, not with it.

The statement is false.

title: Happiness beyond pure income growth
context: Evaluate the following statements to which economic orientation increases happiness in the long term:
statements: An economy that strengthens health, environmental quality and social stability will increase happiness in the long term more than just income growth.
Pure income growth increases happiness more in the long term than an economy that strengthens health, environmental quality and social stability.
This conclusion follows from the findings on the Healthy Lifetime Income.
Social stability does not play a role in this connection and can be neglected.
Long-term happiness does not depend solely on the increase in income in this argument.
tactical_explanations:
Three strengthenings stand against a single income line: health, environmental quality and social stability. The section concludes that such an economy increases happiness more in the long term than merely income increase. The comparison is clear: the trio is the only plus on the account.

Those who make income the sole long-term motor contradict this conclusion.

Long-term and stronger: two words that relativize pure income growth without explaining income for nothing. The conclusion is a trio against a line. Health, environmental quality and social stability together form the orientation that increases happiness more permanently than the mere plus on the account.

This follows from the Healthy Lifetime Income, not from any rating.

The statement is true.

To put pure income increase at the top, the conclusion turns. The illustration says the opposite: health, environmental quality and social stability increase happiness in the long term. The reversal makes the conclusion according to Prettner an income doctrine that the section is currently relativizing.

The statement is false.

The presentation explicitly draws this conclusion from the Healthy Lifetime Income finding. Higher well-being despite only moderate material prosperity, explains why health, environmental quality and social stability are more likely to bear happiness than pure income growth. The sentence calls this derivative, it does not invent it.

"This is the bridge: from the indicator to this economic orientation. Whoever reads the conclusion as an independent wish separates it from the evidence. The sentence holds the derivative.

The statement is true.

Social stability is in the trio of strengthening factors, not at the edge. The conclusion is that health, environmental quality and social stability are common. The irrelevance of social stability would be two dimensions. The representation does not leave this third size.

The statement is false.

The long-term happiness here is not dependent on income growth alone. The comparison sets an economy that strengthens health, environment and social stability above the pure income increase. The sentence holds this relativization to be meaningless without declaring income. It is about the stronger long-term effect, not about zeroing income.

Not only does not mean that income does not matter. It means that as a long-term motor it is not enough in this argument. The trio remains the stronger increase, the income increase the weaker comparative size.

The statement is true.

title: Well-being in the social context
context: Evaluate the following statements on trust, cooperation and equality as factors of well-being:
statements: Wohlbefinden entsteht in einem sozialen Kontext.
Trust, cooperation and equality are key factors.
Well-being arises independently of social relationships, only through individual income.
Equality is one of the key factors, not just trust.
Cooperation is considered to be secondary to GDP.
tactical_explanations:
Social context is the framework of creation, not an optional backdrop. Well-being is not described as a purely private inner world, but as an event in relationships and social relations. Whoever cuts the context makes the finding an individual psychology without society. The sentence applies the explicit formulation of the section.

Without a social context, well-being would be a purely internal balance of the individual household. The section shifts the relationship between the origin and the origin: who trusts, who cooperates, how the society is equal. This shift explains why later lucky values are scattered despite similar GDP. The sentence is the heading about the empirical evidence that follows.

The statement is true.

Trust, cooperation and equality are central factors in a row. None of the three becomes mere marginal notes. The next paragraph provides empirical evidence of equality, inequality and corruption. The list of three is the conceptual bridge there. The sentence completely reproduces it.

The statement is true.

Only through individual income and independent of relationships: that would be the rejection of the social context. The passage says the opposite. Trust, cooperation and equality are central factors, and later comparisons show differences in happiness despite similar GDP. The absolute "only excludes exactly what the presentation puts into the center.

Independence of relationships and the sole effect of income would be the rejection of trust, cooperation and equality. The presentation calls exactly these three central. Later similar GDP and strong material comparison are not enough to equate happiness. The absolute "only falls with it".

The statement is false.

Equality is in the list of factors besides trust and cooperation, not behind them. Whoever only lets trust apply halve the central factors. The next step is to read the World Happiness Report about high social equality. The sentence holds equality in the middle where the representation puts it.

The statement is true.

In addition to GDP, cooperation would only be if happiness alone were related to domestic product. The section calls cooperation a central factor in the social context and later shows that similar GDP does not equate with happiness values. Cooperation is not pushed behind GDP. The devaluation does not affect the presentation.

GDP as a ranking without cooperation would make the social context a footnote. The section makes cooperation the central factor and shows with the Happiness Report that equality and corruption shift values, even if the domestic product is similar.

The statement is false.

title: Equality and World Happiness Report
context: Evaluate the following statements on social equality and the lucky things of the World Happiness Report:
statements: According to World Happiness Report, societies with high social equality (Scandinavian) have the highest happiness values.
The World Happiness Report places Scandinavian societies at the bottom of the lucky list despite high equality.
High social equality is linked to the highest happiness.
Only GDP in this section explains the ranking of the lucky values.
Scandinavia serves as an example of societies with high social equality.
tactical_explanations:
Scandinavia is an example of high social equality in brackets. The World Happiness Report provides the highest lucky, not middle or low. The link runs through equality, not a mere North-South Folklore. The sentence gives evidence and example as the section sets it.

Highest lucky values and high social equality are not listed here as two random parallel lists, but as empirical evidence. Scandinavia illustrates the type of society. The World Happiness Report is the source of ranking, not an arbitrary newspaper commentary.

Whoever cuts the example retains equality without a place; whoever cuts the source retains a claim without the report mentioned.

The statement is true.

The lower end would be the reversal of the order of rank. The presentation says highest lucky values for societies with high social equality, with Scandinavia as an example. A place at the lower end despite equality does not stand there. The sign of evidence remains positive for equality.

The statement is false.

The empirical evidence begins with high social equality and ends with the highest happiness. This is the link, not a loose neighborhood of two lists. Whoever separates equality and happiness, undercuts this first indent. The sentence holds the bond.

The statement is true.

Only putting GDP as an explanation conflicts with the next point: similar GDP is not enough if inequality or corruption are strong. Even the Scandinavian finding is dependent on equality, not on a pure GDP ranking list. The absolute "just" is therefore too narrow for this section.

A pure GDP ranking would make the next indent superfluous. Countries are lower there despite similar GDP if inequality or corruption are strong. Therefore, not only the domestic product can explain the lucky values in this section.

The statement is false.

The parentheses behind high social equality call Scandinavia. The example illustrates the type of society, not any group of countries. Without this example, the category of equality would remain geographically empty. The sentence meets the assignment of the text.

Without the brackets, "high social equality" would remain a type without example. Scandinavia is precisely where the illustration is. The example bears the evidence, it does not replace it with folklore over the north.

The statement is true.

title: Inequality, corruption and similar GDP
context: Evaluate the following statements to be lucky in the event of inequality or corruption despite similar GDP:
statements: Countries with strong inequality or corruption (such as Brazil, South Africa) are significantly lower, even with similar GDP.
With similar GDP, all countries are at the same level of happiness.
Brazil and South Africa are the examples mentioned.
Corruption remains without influence on the lucky values as soon as GDP is comparable.
Inequality or corruption can reduce happiness despite similar GDP.
tactical_explanations:
Brazil and South Africa are examples of strong inequality or corruption. Their happiness levels are significantly lower, and the presentation adds: even with similar GDP. So the domestic product does not compensate for the gap. Evidence contradicts the idea of equal GDP producing equal happiness. The sentence holds together example, level and GDP clause.

The clause "even with similar GDP" is the point, not an addition. It says: the domestic product does not explain the distance to the highest lucky values. Inequality or corruption remain burdensome, Brazil and South Africa remain the examples mentioned. Whoever compares only GDP and cuts the social situation reads the indent against its purpose.

The statement is true.

All countries at the same level of happiness with similar GDP: that would be the reading that the section explicitly defuses. Similar GDP still leaves the values clearly different when inequality or corruption are strong. The all-saying about all countries does not affect this difference.

Allegations and levelling by similar GDP are exactly the misunderstanding that clears out the representation. Lucky values remain different when inequality or corruption are strong. "All countries at one level do not exist in this finding.

The statement is false.

The brackets are called Brazil and South Africa. Other countries may be analogous, but the section shows the point at these two names. Anyone who exchanges the examples leaves the representation. The sentence remains with the mentioned pairing.

The statement is true.

Once GDP is comparable to declaring corruption ineffective, the second half of evidence is not effective. Corruption is not equal to inequality, but is a reason why values are significantly lower, even for similar GDP. Comparable domestic product does not neutralize corruption in this section.

The statement is false.

Reduction despite similar GDP is the point of comparison. Inequality or corruption explain the lower level, not a lack of GDP alone. The sentence summarizes the empirical doctrine without requiring a single index number. Exactly this is how the representation reads the distance to societies with high equality.

In spite of similar GDP, the social situation connects with the lucky ones without memorizing an index figure. The qualitative point is enough: suppressing inequality or corruption, raising equality, raising income alone does not equal.

The statement is true.

title: Participative education and youth
context: Evaluate the following statements on life satisfaction and the fear of the future of young people in participatory education systems:
statements: Young people in countries with participatory education systems report higher life satisfaction.
Dieselben Jugendlichen berichten geringere Zukunftsangst.
Participative education systems increase the fear of the future of young people.
Only adults in Scandinavia, not young people, are the subject of this educational finding.
Participation in the education system is associated with higher life satisfaction and lower anxiety about the future.
tactical_explanations:
Young people, not the entire age structure, are the respondents to this indent. Participative education systems are the framework. Higher life satisfaction is the first reported episode. Those who extend the findings to any school forms without participation leave the presentation. The sentence remains with group, system type and satisfaction direction.

Participation in the education system is the condition, young people are the group, higher life satisfaction is the first episode. If you extend the finding to all schools or all age groups, a dash of a general statement that does not bear the description is made. Exactly in this limitation the statement remains true.

The statement is true.

The second reported episode, which is less fear of the future, is next to the higher level of life satisfaction. Both belong to the same sentence about young people in participatory systems. Fear of the future is falling in this finding, it does not rise. The sentence isolates the second half correctly without deleting the first one.

The statement is true.

Increased fear of the future would be the opposite sign. The section speaks of less fear of the future in participatory education systems. Anyone who makes participation a source of fear twists the empirical evidence. The direction remains relief, not increase fear.

The statement is false.

Setting only adults in Scandinavia is a combination of two points of evidence. Scandinavia illustrates high social equality and highest overall happiness. The educational finding concerns young people in countries with participatory education systems without narrowing this group to Scandinavian adults. The absolute "only adults" does not meet the third indent.

Two lines of evidence must not become one. Scandinavia and equality concern societies and the World Happiness Report. Participative education concerns young people and fear of the future. Setting adults as the only group, cuts the third indent. The absolute "only" is the trap here.

The statement is false.

The connection is double: higher life satisfaction and lower fear of the future. Participation in the education system is the common condition. The sentence summarizes both directions, as the representation puts them side by side. A only more satisfied youth without the fear finding would be incomplete; here are both mentioned.

Both directions belong together because the presentation calls them in one sentence. Satisfaction without the fear finding would be incomplete, fear without satisfaction as well. Participation binds both to the education system, not to any youth program without participation.

The statement is true.

title: Stability and sustainability as a means
context: Evaluate the following statements on the role of economic stability and environmental sustainability:
statements: Economic stability and environmental sustainability are not an end in themselves.
They are means of giving people the freedom to live a good life.
Ecological sustainability is an end in itself, regardless of good life.
Freedom to a good life is the goal that serves stability and sustainability.
Economic stability is considered the ultimate purpose to which good life is subordinate.
tactical_explanations:
Not an end in itself: the section addresses economic stability and ecological sustainability together. Both are separated from the end purpose. They remain important, but as a path, not as a final goal. Whoever raises them to the end in itself, crosses precisely this limit. The sentence reflects the denial of the text.

The goal of self would be to make stability and sustainability the ultimate goal and to re-order the good life of people. The section denies exactly that. Both sizes remain means: important, but related to freedom to a good life. Denial is therefore not a devaluation, but a ranking.

The statement is true.

The expression "does not open up an end in itself." People should have freedom to live; stability and sustainability are the means to do so. Without this purpose, both sizes would be empty-running goals. The sentence meets the positive definition.

Freedom to lead a good life fills the purpose that "does not keep an end in itself." People are in the goal, not the stability index and not the sustainability formula as such. The sentence completely reproduces this positive determination.

The statement is true.

Independence from good life would make sustainability an end in itself. The passage says the opposite: ecological sustainability is a means, not a final end. The good life of people remains the point of reference. The solution contradicts this order of precedence.

The statement is false.

The goal and means are clearly distributed here. Freedom to a good life stands as what stability and sustainability are means for. Serving means subordination to this end, not equal status as an end in itself. The sentence holds the purpose order of the section.

The statement is true.

The ultimate purpose of economic stability with subordinate good life is to reverse the order of priority. The representation gives people freedom to a good life as that which stability is the means for. Stability as the last end would make good life an appendage. That is exactly what the phrase "not an end in itself" rejects.

Subordination of good life to stability as the ultimate purpose would be the reverse end order. The representation gives freedom to good life as what stability is the means for. End purpose stability would make people the appendage of the characteristic number.

The statement is false.

title: Drei Dimensionen nachhaltiger Wirtschaft
context: Evaluate the following statements on the three dimensions that a sustainable economy must integrate:
statements: Eine nachhaltige Wirtschaft muss drei Dimensionen integrieren.
The social dimension requires satisfying the needs of all and reducing inequalities.
Two dimensions, social and ecology alone, are sufficient.
The ecological dimension requires that we remain within planetary boundaries.
The psychological dimension is explicitly omitted in the list of threes.
tactical_explanations:
Three dimensions, not a guiding principle alone: this is how the section opens the requirement for a sustainable economy. Integrating means bringing it together, not using one of them as a label. The following numbering counts socially, ecologically and psychologically. The sentence meets duty and number.

Number and verb belong together: three dimensions, and they must be integrated. A single guide, for example, only ecology or income, does not meet the requirement. The numbering of social, ecological, psychological makes the three concrete. Integration means merging, not labelling.

The statement is true.

Social means double: satisfying the needs of all and reducing inequalities. Both are part of the first dimension. Whoever only calls care and leaves inequality, does not meet the social requirement of the text. The sentence represents both sub-sets.

All and reduce: the social dimension is double task. Satisfying needs without reducing inequalities would be too little, reducing inequalities without satisfying needs as well. The presentation requires both in one point.

The statement is true.

Only two dimensions would eliminate the psychological. The representation requires integration of three dimensions and numbers them through. Sufficient social and ecology alone does not stand there. The shortening undercuts the requirement.

The statement is false.

Stay within planetary boundaries: that is the ecological dimension in a sentence. The dimension does not exhaust itself in an environmental feeling without limit. The sentence keeps the formulation of the text.

Planetary boundaries give the ecological dimension a hard edge. Staying within is more than environmental friendliness without measure. The formulation makes staying within planetary boundaries a duty of sustainable economy in this section.

The statement is true.

The omission of the psychological dimension contradicts the numbered list. Point three is explicitly psychological: to allow subjective well-being and sense. A three-part list without this point would be a different structure. The section does not miss the third dimension.

The statement is false.

title: Psychological dimension of sustainability
context: Evaluate the following statements on the psychological dimension of sustainable economy:
statements: The psychological dimension is intended to enable subjective well-being and sense.
Sense does not matter in the three dimensions.
Subjective well-being is part of the psychological dimension, not only material benefit.
The psychological dimension replaces the social and ecological dimension completely.
All three dimensions must be integrated, they are not optional in succession.
tactical_explanations:
Subjective well-being and sense are the double task of the psychological dimension. It is possible to use the verb, not to force or measure it on a single scale. Whoever only calls satisfaction and cuts meaning leaves away the second half. The sentence gives both target words how the representation sets them.

The sense of being in addition to subjective well-being prevents the psychological dimension from being reduced to a mood scale. Making it possible to create space for not to prescribe a happiness quantum. Point three of the list is exactly this double.

The statement is true.

No role for sense would halve the psychological dimension. The representation calls sense beside subjective well-being. In the list of three, this is the content of point three, not a jewel word. The negation does not affect this content.

The statement is false.

Material benefit alone would be a different language, closer to the income plus of previous sentences. Here subjective well-being is in the psychological dimension. The difference to the pure income increase from the Prettner-Schluss remains visible. The sentence assigns subjective well-being to the right dimension.

The statement is true.

The section demands that three dimensions be integrated: social, ecological, psychological. Psychologically, it adds meaning and well-being, it does not erase any need-for-fairness or planetary limits. The logic of substitution contradicts integration.

Replace would be the opposite of integrating. Socially, there is need and inequality, ecologically, planetary boundaries remain, psychologically, well-being and sense are added. None of the three deletes the others. A sustainable economy, which only knows psychology, undercut the requirement of the text.

The statement is false.

Integrating excludes optional succession: you don't choose social today and ecology next year, while psychology is waiting. The sustainable economy must bring together the three dimensions. The final sentence on the emergence of well-being repeats needs, ecological stability and social relationships as simultaneous conditions.

Der Satz trifft diese Gleichzeitigkeit.

Optionally, integration would turn into a queue. The final sentence sets fulfilled needs, ecological stability and social relationships as a simultaneous place of well-being. The verb "integrate" demands precisely this simultaneity for all three dimensions.

The statement is true.

title: Wo Wohlbefinden entsteht
context: Evaluate the following statements on the conditions under which well-being arises:
statements: Well-being is created where needs are met, ecological stability is maintained and social relationships are maintained.
Ecological stability is indispensable for the development of well-being when the needs are met.
Social relations are part of the development of well-being.
Only satisfied needs meet; relationships and ecological stability fall away.
The three conditions are side by side, not as a substitute for each other.
tactical_explanations:
Three places in one sentence: fulfilled needs, preserved ecological stability, well-kept social relationships. Well-being arises there, not with one of the three alone. The sentence is the compaction of the three dimensions into a formula for the formation. Whoever cuts a pillar changes the place. The wording of the section is precisely this triangular condition.

The formula for the creation condenses the three dimensions without introducing new dimensions. Needs refer to social, ecological stability to planetary boundaries, social relationships to the context of trust, cooperation and equality. Well-being has in this sentence a place with three conditions, not one. Whoever cuts one, shifts the place.

The statement is true.

The formula splits into non-reliability of ecological stability with fulfilled needs. The presentation adds ecological stability as a condition of equal importance, not as luxury after supply. Planetary boundaries in the ecological dimension and this generation clause point in the same direction. The non-reliability claim does not apply.

Fulfilling needs as a free letter to drop ecological stability splits this formula. The representation preserves stability as a condition, parallel to the social dimension and the psychological. There is no renunciation there, neither as an exception nor as a ranking after the supply.

The statement is false.

Maintaining social relations is the third part of the formula. It follows the social context with trust, cooperation and equality. Well-being without well-kept relationships would be a different definition. The sentence holds this third pillar.

The statement is true.

Only needs, without relationships and without ecological stability, would be a one-pillar formula. The section writes three sub-sets. The absolute "only" and the fall away of the other two contradict the compaction at the end of the chapter. Fulfillment of needs remains necessary, it is not enough in this formulation alone.

The statement is false.

In this way, the three conditions are syntactically and objectively connected. None replaces the other, all three mark the place of well-being. This corresponds to the integration of social, ecological and psychological dimensions. The sentence describes this equation without inventing a ranking that does not set the representation.

The syntax of the final sentence does not do this: three subsets, one place. Integration of dimensions means the same thing: side by side, not exchangeable for one another.

The statement is true.

title: Environmental and social inequality together
context: Evaluate the following statements on the interaction of environmental quality, equality and happiness:
statements: Noise, air pollution and surface sealing reduce life satisfaction, while clean air, green spaces and intact ecosystems increase it.
High social equality and high lucky values coincide in Scandinavian societies in the World Happiness Report.
With similar GDP, environmental quality and equality no longer have to distinguish the lucky values, because the domestic product already explains everything.
Nature's attachment to nature strengthens mental health and resilience, and is thus on the plus side of the same environmental logic as clean air and green spaces.
Brazil and South Africa are significantly lower despite possible similar GDP, because strong inequality or corruption calls the burden of happiness.
tactical_explanations:
Plus list and minus list belong to the same empirical comparison. Increase by air, green and ecosystems, reduction by noise, pollution and sealing: both directions are in the first block. The sentence sets them against each other without pushing in a third, unnamed environmental size.

This is the environmental side of the social conditions before social equality follows.

Comparison means: the same studies, opposite signs. Anyone who only knows the plus list underestimates noise, pollution and sealing; anyone who only knows the minus list suppresses air, green and ecosystems. The sentence holds both directions before equality and corruption open the social side.

Environment remains the first social prerequisite in addition to the equality mentioned later.

The statement is true.

Scandinavia, high social equality and highest lucky values are the positive counterpart to the later list of inequality in the World Happiness Report. The following is the case: the section reads the highest values about equality, not about a random geographical proximity. The sentence combines example and rank as the representation connects them.

The statement is true.

All this is explained by GDP: that would be the reading that breaks the presentation in two places. First, an economy of health, environmental quality and social stability increases happiness more than just income growth. Second, countries with inequality or corruption are significantly lower despite similar GDP.

The claim that the domestic product alone is rich does not affect the section.

GDP as an all-clarifier would make environmental quality and equality superfluous. The section does the opposite: it measures life satisfaction in the environment, happiness in equality and corruption, and it relativizes pure income increase in relation to health, environmental quality and social stability. Similar domestic product does not erase these differences.

The claim that it already explains everything, does not hit any of the three blocks.

The statement is false.

Nature is directly related to the environmental lists and strengthens mental health and resilience. It is part of the plus side, not to noise and sealing. Clean air and green spaces increase life satisfaction; nature is complementary to the same strand with health and resistance. The sentence correctly classifys it.

The statement is true.

Inequality or corruption, examples of Brazil and South Africa, much lower even with similar GDP: that remains the negative social mirror. The sentence links the country examples to this burden without inventing an exact GDP level. The clause "despite similar GDP" is that of the text. That is precisely why income does not explain the lucky values alone.

The country examples bear the social minus side, analogous to the environmental minus list. Strong, significantly lower, even with similar GDP: three provisions that explain the gap to Scandinavian equality. Without inequality or corruption the distance remains a mystery of the domestic product. The representation gives the social situation as a solution.

The statement is true.

title: Health, income and happiness comparisons
context: Evaluate the following statements to the relationship between healthy lifetime income, material prosperity and happiness comparisons:
statements: According to Prettner et al (2023), countries can achieve significantly higher well-being if life expectancy and health care are better, even with only moderate material prosperity.
Pure income increase remains in the end of the section of the stronger long-term motor of happiness towards health, environmental quality and social stability.
Similar GDP does not automatically place Brazil or South Africa at the same level of happiness as societies with high social equality.
The Healthy Lifetime Income replaces the World Happiness Report, so equality and corruption are irrelevant to well-being.
An economy that strengthens health follows the same logic in this chapter that binds the indicator to life expectancy and care.
tactical_explanations:
Moderate material wealth does not block higher well-being as soon as life expectancy and health care are higher. This is the core of the Healthy Lifetime Income at Prettner et al. 2023. The indicator opens this very case, instead of chaining well-being to peak consumption. The sentence holds together condition and restriction.

The fact that the indicator is visible is a much higher level of well-being despite only moderate material prosperity. Life expectancy and better health care are the conditions, not a later income miracle. Prettner et al. 2023 prove exactly that with the Healthy Lifetime Income. The sentence holds case, conditions and source together.

The statement is true.

Stronger long-term motor pure income: this is the reverse conclusion. The presentation puts health, environmental quality and social stability above the pure increase in income. Whoever puts income back to the top reads the conclusion against the indicator. The ranking remains in favor of the trio.

The statement is false.

The comparison is not clear about automatic equality of the lucky values with similar GDP. Brazil and South Africa are significantly lower when inequality or corruption are strong, even with similar GDP. Scandinavia stands above high equality at the other end. Similar domestic product does not level this difference.

Not automatically the same level: that is the lesson of inequality and corruption. Brazil and South Africa remain the examples, Scandinavia the counter-image of high equality. Similar GDP is not the clause that just excludes levelling.

The statement is true.

The World Happiness Report is not replaced by the Healthy Lifetime Income. Both findings are parallel: health and life on the one hand, equality, inequality and corruption on the other. Equality and corruption remain central social factors. Whoever declares them to be irrelevant, deletes the evidence list.

Two pieces of evidence do not replace each other. The indicator speaks health and life, the report equality and corruption. Both stop. Unimportantness of equality and corruption would delete the indents for social evidence. Such a substitute does not describe the representation.

The statement is false.

Health strengthens in the conclusion and life expectancy plus care in the indicator point in the same direction. An economy that puts health in the foreground translates the finding from the Healthy Lifetime Income into an alignment that carries happiness more than pure income increase. The sentence draws this line without inventing a number.

The statement is true.

title: Means, dimensions and good life
context: Evaluate the following statements the relationship between medium-purpose logic and the three sustainability dimensions:
statements: Economic stability and environmental sustainability remain means of freedom to lead a good life, even if the sustainable economy has to integrate three dimensions.
The ecological dimension (stay within planetary boundaries) makes ecological sustainability an end in itself and cuts the good life.
The social dimension (needs of all, less inequality) fits in with the evidence that high equality is accompanied by high happiness and strong inequality is the key to values.
The psychological dimension (subjective well-being and sense) falls away as soon as stability and sustainability are only means.
Well-being is created in the final sentence where needs, ecological stability and social relationships come together, i.e. where the three dimensions are practical.
tactical_explanations:
The central purpose and three-dimension requirements are in a row, not as contradiction. Stability and sustainability remain means of freedom of a good life; the sustainable economy must nevertheless integrate socially, ecologically and psychologically. Integration describes how it is managed, the purpose says what. The sentence holds both without deleting one.

Why and how are there at different levels? Why: freedom to a good life, therefore not an end in itself. How: integrating three dimensions, social, ecological, psychological. The sentence makes both levels valid. Whoever plays integration against the purpose, makes a sequence of contradictions that the section does not claim.

The statement is true.

Planetary boundaries in the ecological dimension concretely define what to do ecologically. They do not make sustainability an end in itself. Shortly before, economic stability and ecological sustainability are explicitly not an end in itself, but means of good life. Limits remain the condition of good life of reference.

The deletion of good life contradicts this order of precedence.

Within planetary boundaries, the ecological dimension remains concrete, it does not collect the sentence that sustainability is a means. Good life remains the reference, limits remain the condition of ecological economy. The goal of life is to eliminate the good life; the presentation does not stifle it, it gives people the freedom to do so.

The statement is false.

Needs of all and reduction of inequalities on the social side meet the same equality logic as Scandinavia above and Brazil and South Africa below. Lucky things do not follow GDP alone, but the social situation. The dimension is not ornamental, it translates evidence into a requirement for sustainable economy.

The sentence pulls this bridge within the section.

The bridge is internal: social dimension requires less inequality, evidence shows high equality above and strong inequality or corruption below. Lucky things follow this situation, not GDP alone. A sustainable economy that reduces inequalities takes this evidence seriously. The sentence remains within this section.

The statement is true.

The psychological dimension is eliminated as soon as there is a means, and the purpose and the obligation to integrate is confused. The means are stability and sustainability in relation to freedom and good life. The psychological dimension is intended to enable subjective well-being and sense, thus filling the same purpose in terms of content.

It does not fall away, it is one of the three sizes to be integrated.

The statement is false.

The final sentence mentions fulfilled needs, ecological stability and well-kept social relationships. These are the practical places of social, ecological and, about well-being, psychological. Coming together, not single replacement, remains the condition. The sentence reads the compaction as a handle of the three dimensions without adding a fourth, unnamed pillar.

The statement is true.

title: Falling for GDP, absolute and end in itself
context: Evaluate the following statements to typical reductions in social conditions of well-being:
statements: Because well-being is created in a social context, trust, cooperation and equality are sufficient factors to make environmental quality irrelevant for life satisfaction.
Young people in participatory education systems report higher life satisfaction and lower fear of the future; this finding is sidelined, not instead of environmental and equality findings.
A sustainable economy must omit the psychological dimension, because economic stability is already an end in itself.
Intact ecosystems increase life satisfaction measurable, while land sealing lowers them; both effects remain, even if the GDP of two countries is similar.
The section concludes that pure income growth without strengthening health, environmental quality and social stability is the safest way to achieve higher happiness in the long term.
tactical_explanations:
Social context with trust, cooperation and equality stands, but environmental quality as well. Clean air, green spaces and intact ecosystems increase life satisfaction measurable; noise, air pollution and surface sealing they lower. Social factors do not make the environmental list irrelevant.

Anyone who plays out the context against the environment splits two blocks, which the section calls successively as prerequisites. Unimportant environmental quality does not follow from the social context.

Two blocks, one headline. Social requirements include environmental studies and social context. Trust, cooperation and equality do not explain why noise lowers life satisfaction and lifts clean air. Unimportant environmental quality would be a division that does not make the presentation.

The social context is added, it does not delete the environmental list.

The statement is false.

Participative education concerns young people and provides satisfaction plus less fear of the future. The indent complements the evidence of equality, inequality and corruption, it does not replace the environmental studies or the World Happiness Report. In juxtaposition means: several social prerequisites, not a single royal path.

The sentence holds the educational record in this series.

The statement is true.

The omission of the psychological dimension and stability as an end in itself are two mistakes in one sentence. The presentation demands three dimensions, including the psychological one, and at the same time says that economic stability is not an end in itself.

Sustainable economy integrates subjective well-being and sense, rather than canceling it, because stability is supposedly already the goal.

Double displacement: psychological dimension away, stability to the end in itself. The section numbers three dimensions including well-being and sense, and at the same time says that economic stability is not an end in itself, but means to good life. Both halves of the statement fall with it.

The statement is false.

Measurable increase through intact ecosystems and reduction by surface sealing are part of the first empirical list. Similar GDP does not explain in a later sentence differences in luck; it does not delete these environmental effects. The sentence correctly links both signs and states that a comparable domestic product does not cancel out environmental logic.

Genau so bleiben gesellschaftliche Voraussetzungen plural.

Similar GDP does not cancel out environmental impacts, as little as it eliminates differences in happiness through inequality. Intact ecosystems remain plus, sealing remains minus. Plurality of the prerequisites means: environment and social affairs are applied side by side, the domestic product does not level them. The sentence holds both signs and this independence from GDP comparison.

The statement is true.

The safest way to achieve pure income growth without the trio is to reject the conclusion of Prettner. The section concludes the opposite. Health, environmental quality and social stability increase happiness more in the long term than pure income growth. Anyone who declares income growth the safest way ignores indicator and conclusion.

The statement is therefore incompatible with the text.

The statement is false.
